card.name: Words just before poverty or poor
card.fires_on: Small words and word starts right before the word poverty, poor or pauper, such as 'out of', 'fall under the' or 'give to the'. It fires on the word that sets up an expected poverty term.

modes.label: Linking word before poverty
modes.description: A preposition or article just before the word poverty, in phrases about falling into or escaping it.
modes.example: the amount of money a family of four would need to stay out<< of>> poverty.

modes.label: Before poor or pauper
modes.description: The word the or the start of poor or pauper, where the next word names poor people.
modes.example: give half of his goods to<< the>> poor (Lk. 19

modes.label: Compound poverty phrase
modes.description: A modifier inside a term such as fuel poverty.

card.writes: It promotes poverty words in English and Chinese, so it pushes the model to predict poverty as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before poverty or poor is expected to appear.
